rationale: Professional developers paying $10–$40/mo for Cursor, Copilot, or Claude Code are the clear buyer, and the pain — codebases cluttered with dead code after agent iterations — is real, frequent, and affects commercial output quality. Willingness to pay is plausible given existing paid-tool context but unproven for a separate cleanup add-on; this is the critical gap to close. Operational_autonomy reaches 7 (users submit a repo/diff, Claude analyzes and returns a pruned diff, no per-customer manual work), but buyer_clarity just misses the build_gate floor of 6 — it's 7, so gates are met. However, responsiveness_signal is 2 (untested) and total of 6.4 lands below the build threshold of 6.5, so validate is correct: run a landing-page test or post in a developer community before building.
solution_plan: WHAT: A 'post-agent dead-code pruner' — a web service where a developer pastes or uploads a git diff/repo snapshot and receives a clean diff that removes unused imports, stale branches, and abandoned definitions. BUILD: The factory creates a Claude prompt that ingests a diff or file tree, identifies dead code introduced in recent agent sessions, and outputs a ready-to-apply patch; a simple intake form (file upload or GitHub URL) + Stripe payment link ($9 one-time or $19/mo) is the entire front end — no coding by you. SELL: Target developer communities (HN, r/LocalLLaMA, r/cursor, X/Twitter #AIcoding threads) with a free-tier demo on a sample repo; the factory drafts and queues outreach posts for your approval before publishing. MAINTAIN: Users upload → Claude processes → patch file returned via email or download; billing via Stripe, support questions answered by a Claude-powered FAQ bot; your only recurring task is approving outreach batches. CAVEAT: If the tool needs to handle private repos via GitHub OAuth or CI integration, that requires a developer to implement OAuth flows — validate demand first with the simple upload MVP.
notes: All build_gates technically met at these scores (operational_autonomy=7, buildability_with_ai=7, buyer_clarity=7, willingness_to_pay=6), but weighted_total 6.4 is just below the 6.5 build threshold. Validate with a landing page or community post before investing in build.
